cards.text: People are bringing little children to Jesus, so He'll place His hands on them. Here they come, one little one after another.

cards.question: Jesus' disciples see people bringing little children to Him. What do the disciples do?

answers.text: Rebuke the people who brought them
Line the children up for Him
Carry the children to Jesus themselves

cards.text: So the disciples have turned themselves into Jesus' security team, velvet rope and all. Then Jesus sees what they're doing.

cards.question: Jesus sees His disciples rebuking the people who brought the little children, and He is ___.

cards.text: Jesus tells them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!” Security team, you are OFF the clock.

cards.question: Jesus gives a reason His disciples shouldn't hinder the little children. Who does He say the kingdom of God belongs to?
Jesus says that even someone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child can still enter it.
After Jesus says all this, He takes the little children in His arms, places His hands on them and blesses them.

cards.text: Jesus starts on His way, and a man comes RUNNING up and drops to his knees in front of Him. Friend, nobody runs AND kneels for small talk.

cards.question: The man kneels before Jesus and calls Him Good Teacher. What does the man ask Him?

answers.text: What he must do to inherit eternal life
Which commandment is the most important
Where Jesus will be teaching next

cards.text: Jesus answers the man with a question of His own: “Why do you call Me good?” Then Jesus says, “No one is good except God alone.”
Then Jesus runs through some of the commandments: do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.

cards.question: Jesus lists commandments like do not murder and do not steal. What does the man say back?

answers.text: He has kept all of them since his youth
He has broken most of them over the years
He has never been taught all of them

cards.text: Since his youth, he says, and friend, I can't keep my apron clean through ONE batch. Then Jesus looks at him, and loves him.

cards.question: Jesus tells the man there is one thing he lacks: go sell everything he owns and give to the ___.

cards.text: Do that, Jesus tells him, and he'll have treasure in heaven. And then Jesus says, “Then come, follow Me.”

cards.question: Jesus invites the man to sell everything and follow Him. What does the man do?

answers.text: Sells it all that same day
Asks for more time to decide

cards.question: The man was saddened by Jesus' words and went away in sorrow, because he had great ___.

cards.text: The man walks away sad, and Jesus looks around and says to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!” Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, so that's one problem I never had.

cards.question: The disciples are amazed when Jesus tells them how hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God.

cards.text: But Jesus says to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!” This time, friend, there's no word about the rich.

cards.question: Jesus gives a picture of how hard it is for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God. What does He say is easier?

answers.text: A camel passing through the eye of a needle
A boulder floating across the Jordan River
A tower built all the way up to the sky

cards.text: A CAMEL through the eye of a NEEDLE, friend, and I can't thread a needle with a whole mustache helping me. The disciples are even more astonished.

cards.question: The disciples are even more astonished at Jesus' camel picture. What do they ask one another?

answers.text: Why did the rich man leave

cards.question: The disciples ask who then can be saved. Jesus looks at them and says that with man this is impossible, but not with ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus adds, “For all things are possible with God.”
Then Peter, one of the disciples, speaks up: “Look, we have left everything and followed You.” EVERYTHING, friend, and I can't walk away from a batch in the oven without peeking.

cards.question: Peter says the disciples left everything to follow Jesus. What does Jesus say anyone who leaves home or family or fields for His sake and the gospel will receive?

answers.text: A hundredfold in houses and family and fields
A crown to wear on the last day
Nothing at all until the age to come

cards.question: Jesus promises that anyone who leaves home or family or fields for His sake will receive a hundredfold with no persecutions.
Jesus says anyone who leaves home or family or fields for His sake will receive a hundredfold now, and in the age to come, eternal ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus finishes with one more line, about who's first and who's last. Friend, I'm leaning in so far my hat's about to fall off.

cards.question: Jesus finishes with a line about who is first and who is last. What does He say will happen to many who are first?

cards.text: And Jesus says the other half too: the last will be first.
